references.text: Jesus' direct clarification of the disciples' misunderstanding, where he confirms that Lazarus is dead, not sleeping.
Paul uses the same Greek expression to describe those who have "fallen asleep" in death, as a metaphor for deceased Christians.
Reference to those who will "sleep" (die) yet still be transformed at the resurrection, parallel to the disciples' expectation that sleep leads to salvation.
Paul comforts with the assurance that those who have "fallen asleep" in Jesus will be brought with him at his return, linked to the hope of salvation after death.
